**Regraded p1, and now blocking B #31697.** The epic review of #31979 is on that PR. ⛔ Not a claim.

The collector keeps one declaration per `object:name`, whichever package ships it. Phase 1 makes that harmless today, because one holder per action name means there is never a second declaration to lose. B #31697 widens `action` to one holder per namespace. After that, two namespaces' declarations of one action on one object would collapse to whichever the collector kept, at the bare door and at the address alike. That is a first-registered pick (ADR-0150 red line 2). So this card lands before #31697 narrows.
